About Sambrosa

We're a family-owned wellness brand, and we make one thing with a lot of care: Sambrosa Sweet Dreams Night Syrup — a blend of seven organic herbs in real honey, made for people who want a calmer, more consistent nighttime routine.


Why ambassadors love the program

It's free to join, there are no sales quotas, and we don't care how many followers you have. We're looking for people who genuinely use and believe in Sambrosa — honest recommendations to the people who trust you beat big reach every time.


How you earn

You earn a flat $20 for every new customer who orders through your unique link or code — regardless of order size. Your followers get 20% off their first order, so you're sharing a real deal, not just a plug. Refer another ambassador and earn a $5 bonus when they land their first customer. Commissions are reviewed and paid monthly.


Who this is for

Existing Sambrosa customers, wellness and lifestyle creators, parents, caregivers, busy professionals, and community connectors — anyone who naturally recommends the things that work for them.


Ways to share

Nighttime-routine posts, honest reviews, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, blogs, podcasts, your newsletter, or plain old word of mouth. We provide ready-made graphics so you never start from a blank page.


Important program information

We ask for genuine recommendations only — no paid ads on our brand name, no coupon-site posting, no exaggerated health claims. Applications are reviewed within 48 hours, and approved ambassadors get a real-time dashboard from day one.
payout_period: Approved commissions are reviewed and paid monthly using the payment methods available through the Sambrosa Ambassador Program (PayPal or bank transfer).
term_and_condition:
Sambrosa Ambassador Program — Terms of Service

Effective Date: July 13, 2026 (replaces the April 7, 2026 version)

Company: Sambrosa Care Inc.

Address: 9171 Wilshire Boulevard Suite 500, Beverly Hills, CA 90210

Contact: info@sambrosa.com


1. Program Overview

The Sambrosa Ambassador Program (the "Program") is operated by Sambrosa Care Inc. ("Sambrosa," "we," "us"). The Program allows approved individuals ("Ambassadors") to earn commissions by referring new customers to Sambrosa products through unique referral links and discount codes, tracked and managed via the UpPromote platform on our Shopify store. By applying to or participating in the Program, you agree to these Terms. Joining is free: there is nothing to purchase, no inventory, no quotas, and no obligation to post. Sambrosa may modify, suspend, or terminate the Program at any time.


2. Eligibility & Application

You must be at least 18 years old, have the legal authority to enter into binding agreements, reside in a jurisdiction where referral programs are permitted, and provide accurate application information. There is no follower minimum — we value authenticity over audience size. Current employees, contractors, or their immediate household members may not participate unless approved in writing. Applications are approved automatically; Sambrosa reviews accounts after approval and may decline, suspend, or remove any account at its sole discretion (see Section 7). You may not share account credentials or operate multiple Ambassador accounts without written consent.


3. Commission Structure & Payment

3.1 Commission. Ambassadors earn a flat commission of $20.00 USD per new qualifying customer. A "new qualifying customer" is an individual who has never previously placed an order with Sambrosa; is not the Ambassador; is not a member of the Ambassador's household; completes a purchase using the Ambassador's referral link or discount code; and has not previously been referred by another Ambassador.

3.2 One-Time Per Customer. Commission is paid once per unique customer. Repeat purchases by the same customer do not earn additional commission.

3.3 Customer Discount. The Ambassador's link or code gives referred customers 20% off their first order, one use per customer.

3.4 Recruit Bonus. Ambassadors earn a one-time bonus of $5.00 USD when a person they refer to the Program becomes an Ambassador and generates their first qualifying referral sale. This applies one level only: there are no tiers, no downlines, and no ongoing override commissions on other Ambassadors' sales.

3.5 Payment Schedule & Method. Commissions verified in a calendar month are paid monthly, on or around the 15th of the following month, via PayPal or bank transfer through UpPromote. No minimum payout threshold currently applies; we may introduce one with notice under Section 9. You are responsible for keeping your payment information accurate.

3.6 Taxes. Ambassadors are independent contractors (Section 11.1) and solely responsible for their taxes. Sambrosa will issue IRS Form 1099-NEC to U.S. Ambassadors earning $600 or more in a calendar year and may require a completed W-9 before payout.

3.7 Prohibited Commission Scenarios. No commission is earned on self-referrals, household purchases, fraudulent or artificially inflated purchases (Section 7), or orders that are cancelled, refunded, charged back, or disputed. Such commissions may be reversed or deducted from your balance.


4. Ambassador Obligations

4.1 FTC Disclosure (required). You must clearly and conspicuously disclose your material connection to Sambrosa in every piece of promotional content — for example #ad or #sponsored visible without expanding the caption, verbal disclosure in video, written disclosure in blogs. Failure to disclose may result in immediate termination.

4.2 Accurate Representation. Represent the product accurately and consistently with its official label and descriptions. You may quote the label ("for allergy relief, to have a good night's rest"). Share your own genuine experience.

4.3 No Medical Claims. You may not claim the product treats, cures, prevents, or diagnoses any disease beyond its labeling; may not present it as a substitute for medical care; may not market to or reference use by children or during pregnancy; may not state or imply it is "FDA approved"; and may not invent statistics, reviews, or results. Violation is grounds for immediate termination and may expose you to personal legal liability.

4.4 No Spam. No unsolicited bulk messaging, spam, robocalls, SMS blasts, or unauthorized DM campaigns. Authentic, publicly accessible content only.

4.5 No Brand-Name Advertising. Purchasing search or display ads on "Sambrosa" or confusingly similar terms is not permitted.

4.6 Coupon & Deal Sites. Referral links or codes may not be posted on coupon, deal, or cashback sites without prior written approval.

4.7 No Competing Promotions. While participating, you may not simultaneously promote directly competing nighttime allergy/comfort products.


5. Intellectual Property

Sambrosa grants you a limited, non-exclusive, revocable license to use its trademarks, logos, and marketing materials solely to promote the Program. You may not alter brand assets, imply endorsement of other products, register confusingly similar domains or handles, or use brand assets after termination. You retain ownership of your own content but grant Sambrosa a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide license to repost or feature it with credit, unless you opt out in writing. Feedback may be used without compensation.


6. Termination

You may leave the Program at any time by written notice to info@sambrosa.com. Sambrosa may terminate or suspend any account with or without cause upon notice, and immediately without notice for: commission fraud or self-referrals, prohibited medical claims, brand or reputation damage, spam, false application information, or misuse of brand assets. Upon termination, referral links and codes are deactivated and the brand-asset license ends. Verified, undisputed commissions are paid on the next payment cycle; commissions connected to fraud or violations may be withheld, reversed, or forfeited.


7. Fraud & Abuse

Self-referrals, bot traffic, click farms, fake accounts, cookie stuffing, incentivized purchases, or any artificial inflation of referrals are prohibited and are grounds for immediate termination and forfeiture of unpaid commissions. Sambrosa and UpPromote monitor referral activity; participation constitutes consent to such monitoring. Sambrosa may claw back commissions arising from fraudulent or policy-violating activity.


8. Limitation of Liability

THE PROGRAM IS PROVIDED "AS IS" AND "AS AVAILABLE," WITHOUT WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND. NO EARNINGS ARE GUARANTEED. Sambrosa's total liability is capped at the total commissions paid or payable to you in the three (3) months preceding the claim. Sambrosa is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive, or exemplary damages. You agree to indemnify Sambrosa against claims arising from your participation, your content, or your violation of these Terms or applicable law.


9. Modifications

Sambrosa may modify these Terms, commission rates, or payment terms at any time, with at least 14 days' advance written notice (email or dashboard) for material changes. Continued participation after a change constitutes acceptance; your sole remedy if you disagree is to leave the Program under Section 6.


10. Governing Law & Disputes

These Terms are governed by California law. Disputes will be resolved by binding individual arbitration (JAMS or AAA) in Los Angeles County, California; class actions and class-wide arbitration are waived. Either party may seek injunctive relief in court to prevent irreparable harm.


11. Miscellaneous

11.1 Ambassadors are independent contractors — not employees, agents, partners, or joint venturers.

11.2 You may not assign your account or rights without Sambrosa's written consent; Sambrosa may assign freely in a merger, acquisition, or sale.

11.3 These Terms constitute the entire agreement and supersede all prior versions, including the April 7, 2026 Terms of Service.

11.4 If any provision is held invalid, it will be modified to the minimum extent necessary and the remainder stays in force. Failure to enforce a right is not a waiver.

11.5 Notices to Sambrosa: info@sambrosa.com. Notices to you: the email on your account.
